text:
Alex: Following up from todays all-hands  throwing this thread open for any clarification requests on the headcount and team changes. I'll ping Jordan/People as needed.
Maya: Thanks Alex. Main ask: whats the expected time-to-fill for the eng-runtime roles? Hiring cadence matters for our sprint plans.
Priya: Short answer: target fill window 6-10 weeks for senior ICs, 3-6 weeks for mid/junior. Were using priority tags in Greenhouse and doing rolling screens. Link to tracker: https://hr.example.com/reqs (internal)
Jordan: For eng-runtime specifically, were prioritizing the Kernel and Routing hires. If recruiting lags, well pull in contractors for short-term kernel perf work.
Sam: If contractors are used, will we still prioritize knowledge transfer? We don't want tribal knowledge leaks.
Jordan: Yes — contractors must pair with an internal buddy for the first 4 weeks. Handoff checklist will be mandatory.
Leah: On funding: headcount plan is approved for H1. No immediate hiring freeze expected. We will re-evaluate at the end of Q2 if macro conditions shift.
Alex: Can we get a compact headcount snapshot? Even a tiny table is fine.
Priya: Snapshot (H1 plan):
```
Eng +11
  - Runtime +6
  - Infra +2
  - ML infra +1
  - SRE/support +2
Product +3
Go-to-market +2
```
Maya: Are these net additions or do they include internal moves?
Priya: Net additions. We still expect 2-3 internal rotations into runtime for onboarding and domain knowledge.
Maya: Any relocation expectations for Dedicated/onsite customer roles?
Priya: Mostly remote-first. For region-aligned customer roles we may request occasional onsite; relocation is case-by-case for senior hires.
Sam: Curious about manager hires — are we creating new EM roles or converting ICs?
Jordan: A mix. Well promote where leaders emerge, and hire externally for specific management needs (e.g., a senior infra EM if we need scale experience).
Maya: Interview changes? My team has been seeing longer loops.
Priya: Loop update for specialized infra/runtime roles: recruiter screen -> hiring manager -> architecture panel (40m) -> practical take-home (48-72h) -> cross-team bar-raiser. Were trimming duplicative loops where possible.
Alex: Will career levels be impacted for folks who transfer in? My teammate asked about leveling.
Priya: Transfers use standard calibration. If scope increases, managers can request an accelerated review (2 pay cycles) with evidence packet.
Jordan: Ops note  if hiring falls behind, we will re-prioritize roadmap items: non-critical features may shift to later sprints while perf and cost work stay prioritized.
Sam: How soon will org charts be updated? Folks on new teams need clarity for standups.
Priya: Org chart + role matrix scheduled to publish Thu EOD.
DeployBot: Job: publish-org-chart succeeded (artifact: s3://company-assets/org-charts/2026-04-02-v2.pdf) :white_check_mark:
Maya: Thanks. For impacted ICs, are 1:1s scheduled yet? Some on my team haven't heard.
Jordan: Managers should have outreach scheduled this week. If not, escalate to People or DM me.
Alex: I'll collate outstanding Qs and post a short summary tomorrow. If you need a follow-up in-person session, react with :hand: and we'll set a drop-in.
Maya: :hand: posting a couple team-specific questions to my manager now.
Priya: I'll also start a weekly hiring digest in #people-ops with pipeline stages and owners.
Leah: Appreciate everyone's questions; we'll keep the loop tight and transparent.
Alex: Closing this thread tomorrow unless new urgent Qs appear. Thanks all. :pray:
